company.name: Kaiten
company.shortDescription: Kaiten is a powerful, yet simple lean visual management tool, which helps easily manage complex processes across teams and departments
company.description: Kaiten is a visual management system with a focus on a cross-team interaction and complex process transparency. With Kaiten it is easy to keep abreast of your high level business tasks, find blockers and bottlenecks in your process on any level. Kaiten is designed for a companies which are not satisfied with Trello (or any other implementations of basic Kanban system), but still value simplicity and ease of use.
